blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Tracking-by-propagation (TBP) methods perform end-to-end multi-object tracking by propagating track queries across frames, jointly handling detection and identity association without heuristic post-processing while naturally modeling temporal information. However, as detection and association are tightly coupled, detection queries in TBP are expected to discover currently untracked objects and provide complementary current-frame evidence for challenging tracks whose queries and identities are retained. Existing methods largely inherit detection-query formation from single-frame detection and construct such queries before the decoder with little awareness of trajectory states. Consequently, currently untracked objects may be missed, while challenging tracked objects with reduced visibility under occlusion may lack complementary evidence, causing association failures or duplicate responses. To address these issues, we propose TAQ-MOTR, a tracking-aware detection query formation framework that employs a pre-decoder Hybrid Query Generator (HQG) to fuse current-frame image features, track memory, and learnable memory. By conditioning detection queries on trajectory states, TAQ-MOTR adapts them to \rev{the discovery of currently untracked objects and tracked-object complementation We further introduce a training-only auxiliary detection branch whose one-to-one label assignment is decoupled from that of the main tracking branch, providing additional detection supervision to strengthen the shared HQG and decoder for the discovery of currently untracked objects. TAQ-MOTR improves performance on DanceTrack, SportsMOT, and BFT, achieving 72.0 HOTA, 63.1 AssA, and 76.6 IDF1 on the DanceTrack test set. Code is available at https://github.com/Magicmiya/TAQ-MOTR
blocks.zh: 逐项传播(TBP)方法通过跨帧传播轨迹查询来进行端到端的多对象追踪,在不进行热处理后联合处理检测和身份关联,同时自然模拟时间信息. 然而,由于检测和关联紧密结合,预计TBP中的检测询问将发现目前没有跟踪的物体,并为保留询问和身份的质疑轨道提供补充性当前框架证据。 现有方法在很大程度上继承了单帧探测器的探测-静脉形成,并在解码器前构造这种查询,对轨迹状态知之甚少. 因此,目前没有跟踪的物体可能会被错过,而在隐蔽下对能见度降低的跟踪物体提出质疑可能缺乏补充证据,造成关联失败或重复答复。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用TAQ-MOTR(跟踪-知觉检测查询形成框架),采用预解码混合查询生成器(HQG),将当前帧图像特性、跟踪内存和可学习的内存融为一体。 TAQ-MOTR通过在轨迹状态上调节检测查询,使其适应\rev{发现目前未跟踪的物体和跟踪对象互补 我们进一步引入了只培训的辅助检测分支,其一对一的标签分配与主跟踪分支的标签分配脱钩,提供额外的检测监督,以加强共享的HQG和解码器,用于发现目前没有跟踪的物体. TAQ-MOTR改进了DanceTrack,SportsMOT和BFT的性能,实现了72.0 HOTA,63.1 AssA,以及76.6 IDF1的DanceTrack测试集. 代码见https://github.com/Magicmiya/TAQ-MOTR。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multi-object tracking (MOT) aims to localize objects of interest in a video and preserve their identities across frames. It supports applications in autonomous driving, intelligent transportation, video surveillance [ 5 , 20 ] , and sports analytics [ 6 ] . A central challenge in MOT is to jointly handle object discovery and identity preservation under complex motion, occlusion, and appearance variation. Traditional methods usually follow the Tracking-by-Detection (TBD) paradigm, which first detects objects frame by frame and then associates detections over time. Although representative methods such as ByteTrack [ 37 ] are effective, their detectors are optimized mainly for frame-level recognition and are not explicitly conditioned on trajectory states, making detection errors directly affect association.
blocks.zh: 多物体跟踪(MOT)旨在将视频中感兴趣的物体定位,并保存其跨帧身份. 它支持自主驾驶,智能交通,视频监控[5,20],以及运动分析[6]中的应用. MOT中的一项中心挑战是在复杂的运动、隔离和外观变异下共同处理物体发现和身份保存。 传统方法通常遵循"跟踪逐一探测"(TBD)的范式,它首先通过帧检测物体框架,然后随着时间推移进行关联检测. 虽然ByteTrack[37]等具有代表性的方法是有效的,但其探测器主要是为帧级识别而优化的,并且没有明确以轨迹状态为条件,使得探测错误直接影响关联.

blocks.en: Inspired by DETR-style detectors [ 41 ] , recent end-to-end MOT methods extend query-based set prediction to videos by propagating identity-preserving track queries across frames [ 29 , 23 , 35 ] . We refer to this family as Tracking-by-Propagation (TBP). Unlike DETR object queries, which detect all objects in a single image, TBP detection queries operate alongside propagated track queries that maintain existing trajectories. They therefore serve two roles: discovering currently untracked objects and supplying complementary current-frame evidence to challenging retained tracks. Here, currently untracked objects are those without a maintained track query, including newly appearing objects and previously observed objects that have not been initialized or whose tracks have been terminated. Temporarily lost objects with retained track queries remain tracked, even if no tracking result is output in the current frame. Under identity-preserving one-to-one assignment, ground-truth objects associated with propagated track queries are reserved for those queries, leaving detection queries with positive labels only from currently untracked objects. This imbalanced label assignment leaves the detection component insufficiently trained, contributing to the conflict between detection and association [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 受DETR型探测器的启发[41],近期的端对端MOT方法通过跨帧传播身份保留轨迹查询[29,23,35],将基于查询的成套预测扩展至视频. 我们称这个家庭为 " 逐一追踪 " (TBP)。 与在单一图像中检测所有对象的DETR对象查询不同,TBP检测查询与维持现有轨迹的已传播轨迹查询同时运行. 因此,它们发挥两个作用:发现目前没有跟踪的物体和提供补充的当前框架证据,以挑战保留轨道。 这里,目前未跟踪的对象是那些没有保持轨道查询的物体,包括新出现的对象和以前观察到的尚未初始化或轨道已被终止的物体. 暂时丢失的有保留跟踪查询的物体仍然跟踪,即使当前框架中没有跟踪结果。 在保存身份的一对一任务下,与传播的音轨查询有关的地面真人对象被保留给这些查询,而只从目前没有跟踪的物体上留下带有正标的检测查询. 这种不平衡的标签分配使得检测部分训练不足,助长了检测与关联之间的冲突[34].

blocks.en: Existing TBP methods use different query-initialization strategies to support object discovery. MOTR [ 35 ] initializes detection queries with learnable content and positional embeddings (Fig. 1 (a)). Building on learnable query embeddings, MOTRv2 [ 38 ] uses boxes and confidence scores from a pretrained external detector to initialize detection queries (Fig. 1 (b)). This introduces current-frame information indirectly and reduces the tracker’s detection burden, but requires an additional detector. Neither strategy conditions detection query formation on existing trajectory states; distinguishing tracked from currently untracked objects still relies on subsequent interaction with track queries in the decoder.
blocks.zh: 现有的TBP方法使用不同的查询-初始化策略来支持对象的发现. MOTR [35] 初始化带有可学习内容和位置嵌入的检测查询(图1(a)). 在可学习的查询嵌入的基础上,MOTRv2[38]使用预先训练的外部探测器的盒和置信分数来初始化检测查询(图1(b)). 这间接引入了当前帧信息,减轻了跟踪器的探测负担,但需要额外的探测器. 无论是在现有轨迹状态上的战略条件检测查询形成;区分跟踪与目前未跟踪的对象,仍然依赖于在解码器中后续与轨道查询的互动.

blocks.en: Motivated by visual search studies showing that human visual attention is guided by task demands toward informative regions [ 10 , 31 ] , we seek to align detection query formation with current tracking needs. We therefore propose TAQ-MOTR, a tracking-aware detection query formation framework for end-to-end MOT (Fig. 1 (c)). Its Hybrid Query Generator (HQG) initializes proposals from image features and refines them through attention to learnable memory acquired from training data and track memory from previous-frame tracks. After scoring and Top-K selection, the resulting detection queries are aware of already tracked objects before bidirectional interaction with track queries in the decoder, helping focus detection on currently untracked objects.
blocks.zh: 以视觉搜索研究为动机,显示人类视觉注意力受信息化区域的任务要求指导[10,31],我们力求使检测查询形成与当前跟踪需求保持一致. 因此,我们提议采用TAQ-MOTR(图1(c))。 其混合查询生成器(HQG)从图像特性中初始化了建议,并通过注意从培训数据中获得的可学习内存和跟踪从前帧轨道获得的内存来加以完善. 在评分和Top-K选择后,由此产生的检测查询在解码器中与轨迹查询进行双向交互之前就已经意识到了跟踪对象,帮助聚焦当前未跟踪对象的检测.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we add a training-only auxiliary detection branch to improve detection-side learning under sparse supervision. It reuses the image-based detection proposals and shares HQG and decoder parameters with the main branch, but excludes track memory and blocks interaction with the main queries through attention masks. Its proposal and decoder predictions are independently matched to all current-frame ground-truth objects, preserving one-to-one assignment within each branch and supervising HQG and the decoder through their respective losses. This design supports joint optimization within the end-to-end tracker without an external detector or additional trainable parameters, and the auxiliary branch is removed at inference.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们增设了一个专门培训的辅助检测处,以便在有限的监督下改进检测方面的学习。 它重用基于图像的检测建议,并与主分支共享HQG和解码器参数,但排除了跟踪内存,并通过注意口罩阻断与主询问的相互作用. 其建议和解码器的预测与所有当前框架的地面事实对象独立对应,在每个分支内保留一对一的任务,并监督总部总部和解码器各自的损失。 这种设计支持端到端跟踪器内部的联合优化,没有外部探测器或额外的可列车参数,辅助分支在推论中被移除.

blocks.en: We evaluate TAQ-MOTR on DanceTrack [ 28 ] , SportsMOT [ 6 ] , and BFT [ 40 ] , achieving the highest HOTA among the compared TBP methods on all three benchmarks. The association gains and competitive detection performance support the benefit of forming detection queries with awareness of existing track states.
blocks.zh: 我们评价TAQ-MOTR在DanceTrack[28],SportsMOT[6],以及BFT[40],在所有三个基准的比较TBP方法中实现了最高的HOTA. 关联收益和竞争性检测性能有助于形成了解现有跟踪状态的检测查询。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows: 1. We propose TAQ-MOTR to make detection query formation tracking-aware in TBP-based MOT. It introduces trajectory-state conditioning before decoder interaction, enabling detection queries to adapt to their shifted role in query propagation while retaining the unified TBP decoding framework. 2. We design a Hybrid Query Generator (HQG) that integrates image feature proposals, track memory, and learnable memory to form tracking-aware detection queries before decoding, enabling them to focus on tracking-relevant regions for the discovery of currently untracked objects and complementary evidence provision. 3. We introduce a training-only auxiliary detection branch with a stage-wise training strategy to provide additional detection supervision through decoupled label assignments between the auxiliary and main tracking branches. By strengthening detection query learning without competing with track queries for labels, this branch improves detection quality and further benefits identity association.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下: 1. 我们建议TAQ-MOTR在基于TBP的MOT中使检测查询阵列跟踪意识. 它在解码器交互之前引入了轨迹状态条件,使得检测查询能够适应其在查询传播中转变的作用,同时保留统一的TBP解码框架. 2. 我们设计了一个混合查询生成器(HQG),将图像特性建议、跟踪内存和可学习的内存整合起来,在解码前形成跟踪-意识检测查询,使其能够侧重于跟踪相关区域,以便发现目前没有跟踪的物体并提供补充证据。 3. 我们引入了一个只有培训的辅助检测分支,具有分阶段培训战略,通过辅助检测分支和主要跟踪分支之间的分离标签任务,提供额外检测监督。 通过加强检测查询学习,而不与跟踪查询竞争标签,这个分支提高了检测质量,并进一步惠及身份联系.

It introduces trajectory-state conditioning before decoder interaction, enabling detection queries to adapt to their shifted role in query propagation while retaining the unified TBP decoding framework.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multi-object Tracking Paradigms
blocks.zh: 2.1 多物体跟踪参数

blocks.en: Multi-object tracking (MOT) methods can be broadly categorized by how object detection and temporal association are coupled. Tracking-by-Detection (TBD) first performs frame-wise detection and then associates detection results across frames. Representative trackers, such as ByteTrack [ 37 ] , OC-SORT [ 3 ] and Hybrid-SORT [ 33 ] , improve this pipeline by recovering low-confidence detections, refining motion modeling, or combining complementary association cues. Despite their effectiveness, the separated pipeline makes track initialization and identity continuity rely heavily on detector quality and hand-crafted matching. Missed or inaccurate detections may therefore lead to target loss, trajectory fragmentation, and identity switches.
blocks.zh: 多对象跟踪(MOT)方法可以按照物体检测和时间关联的结合方式进行广泛的分类. 逐帧检测(TBD)首先进行帧检测,然后联系跨帧检测结果. 具有代表性的追踪器,如ByteTrack[37],OC-SORT[3]和Hybrid-SORT[33],通过恢复低信心检测,精炼运动模型,或结合互补关联提示来改进这一管道. 尽管它们有效,但分离的管道使轨道初始化和身份连续性严重依赖探测器质量和手工匹配。 因此,检测失败或不准确可能导致目标丢失、轨迹破碎和身份开关。

blocks.en: Inspired by DETR [ 4 ] , recent end-to-end MOT methods couple detection and association through query-based set prediction. TransTrack [ 29 ] uses target features from the previous frame as tracking queries, while TrackFormer [ 23 ] and MOTR [ 35 ] further develop query propagation for identity-preserving tracking. MeMOTR [ 8 ] further incorporates long-term memory into track-query updates to maintain identity consistency. In the TBP paradigm, propagated track queries and detection queries are jointly decoded in a shared decoder, enabling unified optimization of object discovery and identity association. However, this tight coupling also changes the role of detection queries. Beyond the discovery of currently untracked objects, detection queries are expected to provide complementary current-frame evidence for challenging tracked objects under occlusion, crossing, or overlap. This dual role makes detection query formation before shared decoding crucial for TBP-based MOT.
blocks.zh: 受DETR[4]的启发,近期的端对端MOT方法通过基于查询的组合预测进行夫妇检测和关联. TransTrack [29] 使用前一个帧中的目标特性作为跟踪查询,而TrackFormer [23]和MOTR [35] 进一步发展用于身份保存跟踪的查询传播. MeMOTR [8] 进一步将长期内存纳入轨迹-query更新,以保持身份一致性. 在TBP范式中,传播的轨道查询和检测查询在一个共享的解码器中共同解码,从而能够统一优化对象发现和身份关联. 然而,这种紧密的结合也改变了检测查询的作用. 除了发现目前没有跟踪的物体外,预计探测查询还将为在隔离、穿越或重叠下对跟踪物体提出质疑提供补充性的现有框架证据。 这种双重作用使得共享解码前的检测查询形成对于基于TBP的MOT至关重要.

blocks.en: Another line of end-to-end MOT revisits the separation between object detection and identity association. LA-MOTR [ 30 ] decouples object detection and trajectory association into dedicated modules, while MOTIP [ 7 ] formulates association as in-context ID prediction over frame-level object representations. Although these methods reduce the entanglement between detection and association, their detection stage is largely driven by single-frame object evidence before identity reasoning. As a result, detection is less directly conditioned on propagated track states, leaving limited room for track memory to guide current-frame object discovery and complement challenging tracked objects. TAQ-MOTR therefore focuses on a different setting: it preserves the TBP formulation with a unified query-propagation decoder, and improves detection query formation before decoding by making detection queries tracking-aware.
blocks.zh: 另一条端对端的MOT线重新审视了物体检测与身份关联之间的分离. LA-MOTR [30] 将对象检测和轨迹关联解为专用模块,而MOTIP [7] 则在帧层对象表示上将关联作为内文本ID预测而形成. 虽然这些方法减少了检测和关联之间的纠缠,但其检测阶段在身份推理之前主要是由单帧物体证据驱动的. 因此,检测不直接以传播的轨迹状态为条件,给轨迹内存留下了有限的空间来指导当前帧物体的发现并补充挑战性的跟踪物体. TAQ-MOTR因此专注于不同的设置:它用统一的查询-传播解码器保存TBP配方,并通过使检测查询跟踪-意识来改进解码前的检测查询形成.

blocks.en: 2.2 Detection Query Formation in End-to-End MOT
blocks.zh: 2.2 检测端到端的MOT中的查询

blocks.en: End-to-end MOT methods such as MOTR [ 35 ] build on DETR-style object detectors [ 4 ] . In MOTR, detection queries are initialized with a fixed-size set of learnable content and positional embeddings. These embeddings acquire shared detection priors from the training data, providing a consistent initialization across frames. However, they are not conditioned on current-frame observations or existing track states. Detection queries therefore rely on subsequent interactions with image features and track queries in the decoder to localize objects and distinguish currently untracked objects from those already tracked. This lack of guidance at initialization can leave early decoder attention insufficiently focused on relevant object regions, limiting how effectively detection queries extract features for tracking. To incorporate current-frame object information, MOTRv2 [ 38 ] uses proposals from a pretrained external detector to initialize detection queries, but its proposal generation does not incorporate existing track states or undergo joint optimization with the tracker.
blocks.zh: 末端到末端的MOT方法,如MOTR [35] 建立在DETR式的物体探测器上[4]. 在MOTR中,检测查询以一组固定大小的可学习内容和位置嵌入物初始化. 这些嵌入物从培训数据中获取了共享的检测前科,提供了连续的跨框架初始化. 然而,它们不以目前框架的观察或现有跟踪状态为条件。 因此,检测查询依赖于在解码器中后续与图像特征的交互和跟踪查询,将对象定位,并将目前未跟踪的物体与已经跟踪的物体区分开来. 这种初始化时缺乏指导的情况可能使早期解码器的注意力没有足够集中于相关的对象区域,从而限制了检测查询提取跟踪功能的有效性. 为了纳入当前帧对象信息,MOTRv2[38]使用经过预先训练的外部探测器的建议来初始化检测查询,但其建议生成没有包含现有的跟踪状态,也没有与跟踪器进行联合优化.

blocks.en: Contextual conditioning in related vision tasks provides further inspiration for query formation. SAM 2 [ 24 ] conditions current-frame image representations on object-specific memory for segmentation, with memory attention and mask decoding performed separately for each object. SAM2MOT [ 12 ] , for example, adds a separate cross-object interaction module to coordinate memory updates under occlusion while retaining per-object segmentation. In object detection, RT-DETRv2 [ 22 ] selects scored image-based proposals to initialize decoder queries and jointly trains proposal generation with all-object supervision. Extending image-based proposal initialization to TBP also requires conditioning on existing trajectory states.
blocks.zh: 相关视觉任务中的背景条件为查询形成提供了进一步的启发. 萨姆 2[24]在对象特定内存上设置条件当前帧图像表示,用于分割,对每个对象分别进行内存注意和口罩解码. 例如,SAM2MOT [12] 增加了一个单独的交叉对象交互模块,在隔离下协调内存更新,同时保留每个对象的分区. 在对象检测中,RT-DETRv2[22]选择了基于图像的得分建议,以初始化解码查询,并在全对象监管下联合培训建议书生成. 将基于图像的建议书初始化扩大到TBP还需要在现有轨迹状态上加以限制.

blocks.en: HQG extends image-based proposal initialization with track-state conditioning before joint MOT decoding, while preserving the unified TBP framework.
blocks.zh: HQG在联合MOT解码之前延长了基于图像的初始化建议,并带有轨迹状态的调节,同时保留了统一的TBP框架.

blocks.en: 2.3 Query Competition and Detection-side Supervision
blocks.zh: 2.3 查询竞争和侦查监督

blocks.en: Supervision strategies in end-to-end MOT differ in how they balance detection learning with identity-preserving tracking.
blocks.zh: 端到端的MOT监督战略在检测学习与保存身份跟踪之间如何平衡上有所不同.

blocks.en: MOTRv3 [ 34 ] redistributes labels between detection and track queries through release-fetch supervision, while CO-MOT [ 32 ] extends detection supervision to tracked objects in intermediate decoder layers and introduces shadow query sets. These strategies modify supervision within the main decoder. Our approach instead uses a separate auxiliary query group with independent all-object matching, drawing on query grouping and attention masking in DN-DETR [ 15 ] . This supplies additional detection supervision while preserving the main branch’s identity-preserving assignments.
blocks.zh: MOTRv3 [34]通过释放-牵引监理在检测和跟踪查询之间重新分配标签,而CO-MOT [32]将检测监理扩展至中间解码层的跟踪对象,并引入阴影查询集. 这些策略修改了主解码器内的监管. 我们的方法使用一个单独的辅助查询组,具有独立的全对象匹配,在DN-DETR [15] 中借鉴查询组和注意力掩码. 这提供了额外的检测监督,同时保留了主要分支的保存身份的任务。

blocks.en: 3 Our Approach
blocks.zh: 3. 我们的方针

blocks.en: 3.1 Overall Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 总体结构

blocks.en: TAQ-MOTR is an end-to-end MOT framework that forms tracking-aware detection queries before decoder interaction. As shown in Fig. 2 , given an input frame I t I_{t} , a backbone and an RT-DETR-style hybrid encoder extract multi-scale image features [ 39 ] . These features serve as visual context for the DAB-Deformable DETR decoder [ 18 , 41 ] , while the lowest-resolution feature map is projected into image-based detection proposals for the Hybrid Query Generator (HQG). In parallel, track queries T t − 1 T_{t-1} propagated from the previous frame are updated by the track-query updater. The updated propagated track queries are used as decoder queries for identity-preserving tracking and are also converted into track memory for HQG.
blocks.zh: TAQ-MOTR是一个端到端的MOT框架,在解码器交互之前形成跟踪-知觉检测查询. 如图2所示,由于一个输入框架I t I_{t},一个骨干和一个RT-DETR风格的混合编码器提取多尺度图像特性[39]. 这些特性作为DAB-变形DETR解码器的视觉上下文[18,41],而最低分辨率的特性图则投射到混合查询生成器(HQG)的基于图像的检测建议中. 同时,从前一个帧传播的轨迹查询T t − 1 T_{t-1}由轨迹-query更新器更新. 更新的已传播的音轨查询被用作身份保存跟踪的解码查询,并被转换成HQG的音轨内存.

In the main tracking branch, HQG uses image-based detection proposals as queries and reads track memory and learnable memory as keys/values. The generated detection queries are concatenated with updated track queries and jointly decoded. During training, an auxiliary detection branch shares the detection proposals and HQG layers but removes track memory, producing a separate detection-query group supervised by all current-frame objects. Attention masks isolate this auxiliary group from the main query groups. The right panel shows an HQG layer.

blocks.en: The main tracking branch is active during both training and inference. HQG takes the detection proposals as input queries and allows them to interact with two memory sources: track memory, which encodes existing trajectory states, and learnable memory, which stores trajectory-agnostic detection priors. The resulting detection queries therefore combine current-frame object evidence, track-state priors, and learned detection priors before entering the decoder. They are concatenated with the updated track queries and jointly decoded. High-confidence detection-query outputs are initialized as new track queries, while active propagated track queries are updated to continue existing trajectories. Following the missing-frame tolerance principle in MOTR [ 35 ] and MeMOTR [ 8 ] , established tracks are retained during temporary loss until the configured missing-frame tolerance is reached. Retained track queries continue to participate in decoding; once a retained query again produces a reliable prediction, tracking resumes with the same identity. These objects remain tracked even when no current-frame output box is produced. Exclusion from HQG’s conditioning memory does not itself delete a retained track query or its identity. Once the tolerance is reached, the track query is deleted, and its ID is permanently retired and will not be restored or reassigned. A later detection of the same physical object therefore initializes a new track with a new identity. The newly initialized and retained track queries together form T t T_{t} for propagation to the next frame.
blocks.zh: 主要的跟踪部门在培训和推论期间都很活跃. HQG将检测建议作为输入查询,并允许它们与两个内存源进行交互:跟踪内存,它编码了现有的轨迹状态,以及可学习的内存,它存储了轨迹-不可知检测前科. 因此,由此产生的检测查询在进入解码器之前,结合了当前帧对象证据、跟踪状态前科和所学的检测前科。 它们与更新的音轨查询相配合,并联合解码. 高自信检测-平滑输出作为新音轨查询初始化,而主动传播的音轨查询则更新以延续现有的轨迹. 遵循MOTR [35]和MeMOTR [8]中的缺失框容性原则,在临时损失期间保留既定的音轨,直至达到配置的缺失框容性. 保留轨迹查询继续参与解码;一旦保留查询再次产生可靠的预测,则追踪恢复具有相同身份. 即使没有生产出当前框架输出框,这些物体仍能跟踪。 排除HQG的调制内存本身不会删除保留的音轨查询或其身份. 一旦达到容忍度,则删除音轨查询,其ID永久退役,不会恢复或重新分配. 后期对同一物理物体的探测因此初始化了具有新身份的新轨道. 新初始化和保留的音轨查询一起组成 T t T_{t} 以传播到下一个帧 。

blocks.en: For tracked-object complementation, HQG conditions detection queries on current-frame image evidence, track memory, and learnable memory. Following MOTR [ 35 ] , retained track queries read detection-query features through decoder self-attention (SA) to complement the representations used for their predictions, while the existing identities remain assigned to the track queries.
blocks.zh: 对于跟踪对象补充,HQG为检测当前帧图像证据的查询,跟踪内存,以及可学习的内存提供条件. MOTR [35] 之后,保留了轨迹查询通过解码器自留心(SA)读取检测-query特性,以补充用于预测的表示,而现有的身份仍然被分配到轨迹查询.

blocks.en: The training-only auxiliary branch strengthens detection-side learning without changing the inference pipeline. It reuses the same detection proposals and HQG-layer weights as the main branch, but excludes track memory and reads only learnable memory. The auxiliary queries are decoded together with the main queries, isolated by attention masks, and supervised by all ground-truth objects in the current frame. They are not used for tracking prediction and are not propagated to subsequent frames.
blocks.zh: 仅训练辅助分支在不改变推论管道的情况下加强检测侧学习. 它重用与主分支相同的检测建议和HQG层的权重,但排除了轨迹内存,只读可学习的内存. 辅助查询与主查询一起解码,用注意力罩隔开,并由当前框架中的所有地面真人物体监督. 它们不用于跟踪预测,也不向后续框架传播。

blocks.zh: 3.2 混合查询发电机

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 2.2 , detection queries in TBP-based MOT do not simply inherit DETR’s full-image discovery role. Existing targets are mainly maintained by propagated track queries, whereas detection queries should discover currently untracked objects and provide complementary current-frame evidence for tracked targets under occlusion, crossing, or overlap. HQG addresses this tracking-specific role by organizing three prior carriers before decoding: learnable memory, track memory, and image-based detection proposals. Its position in the overall architecture is shown in Fig. 2 , and the three prior carriers are decomposed row by row in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh: 如第2.2节所述,基于TBP的MOT中的检测查询并不只是继承DETR的全图像发现作用。 现有目标主要是通过传播跟踪查询来维持,而检测查询应发现目前没有跟踪的物体,并为被隔离、穿越或重叠的跟踪目标提供补充的当前框架证据。 HQG通过在解码前组织三个前载体来解决这个跟踪特定的作用:可学习内存,跟踪内存,以及基于图像的检测建议. 它在整体架构中的地位如图2所示,前三艘航空母舰在图3中逐行分解.

blocks.en: 3.3 Detection-only Auxiliary Learning
blocks.zh: 3.3 仅检测的辅助学习

blocks.en: Although HQG conditions detection queries on track states, one-to-one assignment still limits their positive supervision. Ground-truth identities held by maintained track queries, including temporarily lost queries, are reserved for those queries. Main detection queries are matched only to currently untracked objects, whose identities are not held by any maintained track query. At clip initialization, they can match all current-frame objects. Auxiliary queries are independently matched to all current-frame objects at supervised layers when their branch is active on non-initial clip frames. This supervision imbalance weakens detection-side learning, making detection queries less effective in discovering currently untracked objects and in providing complementary current-frame evidence for challenging tracked targets.
blocks.zh: 虽然HQG在轨状态下具备检测查询的条件,但一对一的任务仍然限制了他们的正面监督. 为这些查询保留了有轨迹查询(包括暂时丢失的查询)的地面真实身份。 主要检测查询只匹配当前未跟踪的对象,其身份不被任何维护的音轨查询所持有. 在剪辑初始化时,它们可以匹配所有当前帧对象. 当分支在非初始剪辑框上活动时,辅助查询会独立匹配所有受监管层的当前帧对象. 这种监督不平衡削弱了检测方学习,使检测查询在发现目前没有跟踪的物体和为挑战跟踪目标提供补充性当前框架证据方面不太有效。

It follows the query grouping and attention masking strategy of DN-DETR [ 15 ] , but does not construct denoising queries from ground-truth annotations. Instead, it reuses the same image-based detection proposals as the main branch to form a separate detection-query group. The auxiliary branch shares the initial proposals 𝐃 ^ t det \widehat{\mathbf{D}}_{t}^{\mathrm{det}} and HQG-layer weights with the main branch, but removes track memory from cross-attention: H t , aux 0 \displaystyle H_{t,\mathrm{aux}}^{0} = 𝐃 ^ t det , \displaystyle=\widehat{\mathbf{D}}_{t}^{\mathrm{det}}, (6) H t , aux l + 1 \displaystyle H_{t,\mathrm{aux}}^{l+1} = HQGBlock ⁡ ( H t , aux l , 𝐌 learn ) . \displaystyle=\mathrm{HQGBlock}(H_{t,\mathrm{aux}}^{l},\mathbf{M}^{\mathrm{learn}}). Thus, the auxiliary queries retain current-frame image evidence and learnable detection priors while remaining independent of propagated track states.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 2 , the auxiliary queries are decoded together with the main detection queries and track queries, but attention masks block information exchange between the auxiliary group and the main query groups. The main branch performs tracking prediction, track-query update, and query propagation. The auxiliary branch is used only for detection losses on non-initial clip frames when enabled by the training schedule: its outputs are independently matched with all ground-truth objects in the current frame, and its queries are discarded after training. Both branches share HQG and decoder parameters, including their prediction heads, without adding trainable parameters or competing with track queries for positive labels. This design strengthens current-frame object discovery and complementary evidence learning without increasing inference cost or disrupting the unified TBP decoder.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,辅助查询与主检测查询和跟踪查询一起解码,但注意力遮挡了辅助组与主查询组之间的信息交流. 主要分支进行跟踪预测、跟踪和查询更新。 辅助分支仅用于在培训时间表允许时检测非初始剪辑框的损失:其输出与当前帧中的所有地面真实物体独立匹配,其询问在培训后被丢弃. 两个分支共享HQG和解码器参数,包括它们的预测头,不添加可训练参数,也不与轨道查询竞争正标签. 这种设计可以加强当前帧对象的发现和补充证据的学习,同时又不会增加推论成本或破坏统一的TBP解码器.

blocks.en: Selected Top-K proposals receive Varifocal Loss (VFL) for classification and L1 and generalized IoU (GIoU) losses for box regression. Main-branch proposals are matched to currently untracked ground-truth objects; active auxiliary proposals are independently matched to all current-frame ground-truth objects. These losses train the proposal heads and preceding HQG layers without differentiating through the ranking indices. The selected-proposal losses directly supervise HQG, whereas decoder-level losses optimize the decoder without backpropagating through the detached query-initialization tensors. Proposal supervision is retained throughout training.
blocks.zh: 部分Top-K建议书获得Varifocal Loss(VFL)用于分类,L1和通用IoU(GIoU)用于框回归的损失. 主要部门的建议与目前没有跟踪的地面真人对象相匹配;主动辅助建议与所有当前框架的地面真人对象独立匹配。 这些损失对建议书头和总部总部各层进行训练,没有通过排名指数加以区分。 选定的建议书损失直接监督HQG,而解码器级损失则通过脱开的查询-初始化连载器,在不背传的情况下优化解码器. 在整个培训过程中保留对提案的监督。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmarks and Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准和计量

blocks.en: We use three benchmarks: DanceTrack [ 28 ] , SportsMOT [ 6 ] , and Bird Flock Tracking (BFT) [ 40 ] . DanceTrack features similar appearances, crossings, and occlusions; SportsMOT introduces fast motion, viewpoint changes, and small targets in wide-view scenes. BFT extends evaluation to non-human targets with rapid motion, deformation, and occlusion. We report HOTA as the primary overall metric, DetA and AssA for detection and association quality [ 19 ] , IDF1 for identity preservation [ 25 ] , and MOTA for frame-level tracking errors [ 1 ] . Best and second-best results are highlighted among Tracking-by-Propagation (TBP) methods, which propagate track queries across frames.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个基准: DanceTrack [28], SportsMOT [6], 和 Bird Flock Track (BFT) [40]. DanceTrack具有类似的外观、交叉和隔离;SportsMOT在宽视场景中引入快速运动、视角变化和小目标。 BFT将评价扩展至具有快速运动、变形和隔离的非人类目标。 我们报告说,HOTA是主要的总体衡量标准,DetA和AsSA用于检测和关联质量[19],FID1用于身份保护[25],MOTA用于帧级跟踪错误[1]。 在逐项跟踪(TBP)方法中强调了最佳和次最佳结果,这些方法跨越框架传播跟踪查询。

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en: TAQ-MOTR follows the MeMOTR framework [ 8 ] for query propagation and long-term memory. The model uses RT-DETRv2 weights pretrained on COCO [ 22 , 17 ] , a PResNet-50vd backbone, and the RT-DETRv2 Hybrid Encoder. The decoder follows DAB-Deformable DETR [ 18 , 41 ] with six layers and takes three feature levels with strides of 8, 16, and 32. HQG constructs image-based detection proposals from the stride-32 feature level. The first decoder layer updates only detection-side queries, while the remaining layers jointly decode detection queries and propagated track queries. Unless otherwise specified, HQG uses 200 main detection queries and 200 detection-only auxiliary queries. HQG contains three layers that share a set of 32 learnable memory tokens.
blocks.zh: TAQ-MOTR遵循MeMOTR框架[8]进行查询传播和长期内存. 该型号在COCO[22,17]上使用RT-DETRv2预训重量,一个PResNet-50vd主干线,以及RT-DETRv2混合编码器. 解码器遵循DAB-变形DETR [18,41],分6层,并采用3个特征级,步数分别为8,16和32. HQG从strip-32特性级别构建基于图像的检测建议. 第一层解码层仅更新检测侧查询,其余各层则联合解码检测查询并传播音轨查询. 除非另有说明,HQG使用200个主检测查询和200个仅检测的辅助查询. HQG包含三层,共享一套32个可学习的内存符号.

blocks.en: Training uses NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPUs. DanceTrack is the main benchmark for selecting the default configuration and conducting ablations, and its default model is trained for 30 epochs on four GPUs. We adopt a progressive training curriculum based on MeMOTR [ 8 ] : training clips are sampled with random temporal intervals of up to 10 frames, and the clip length gradually increases from 2 to 5. Within this curriculum, we remove intermediate-layer auxiliary decoder losses at epoch 14 and disable the auxiliary branch at epoch 24. SportsMOT uses the same architecture with a 42-epoch schedule; the entire auxiliary branch is disabled at epoch 36, the beginning of the final training stage. BFT uses the same architecture with a 50-epoch schedule, with training stages and auxiliary-supervision transitions proportionally mapped from the DanceTrack schedule.
blocks.zh: 训练使用NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU. DanceTrack是选择默认配置和进行调试的主要基准,其默认模型在四个GPU上为30个纪元进行了训练. 我们采用基于MeMOTR[8]的渐进式培训课程:随机抽取时间间隔不超过10帧的培训剪辑,剪辑长度从2个逐渐增加到5个. 在这个课程中,我们取消了中间层辅助解码器在14号区的损失,并在24号区禁用辅助分支. SportsMOT使用相同的架构,具有42个划时代的时间表;整个辅助分支在36号划时代被禁用,这是最终训练阶段的开始. BFT使用相同的架构,具有50个划时代的时间表,其培训阶段和辅助-超视距过渡由DanceTrack时间表按比例映射.

blocks.en: For tracker training in the main comparisons, TAQ-MOTR uses only the official training split of each benchmark; COCO detector pretraining is specified above and is distinct from additional tracking-training data. We additionally report a SportsMOT variant trained with additional CrowdHuman data, marked with ‡ and excluded from the main ranking. TAQ-MOTR performs online tracking without offline trajectory linking, smoothing, or interpolation. Outputs undergo per-frame confidence filtering.
blocks.zh: 对于主要比较中的跟踪器培训,TAQ-MOTR只使用每个基准的官方培训分法;COCO探测器预培训在上文有明确规定,有别于额外的跟踪培训数据. 此外,我们还报告一个SportsMOT的变体,该变体训练了额外的人群数据,标记为QQ,被排除在主要排名之外。 TAQ-MOTR进行在线跟踪,不进行离线轨迹连接、平滑或插值。 产出经过每帧置信过滤。

blocks.zh: 4.3 与最新方法的比较

blocks.zh: 图5 TAQ-MOTR的模块级效率分析. 对主干线,混合编码器,解码器,HQG,以及查询更新器,则显示四舍五入参数计数和报告每帧运行时间.

blocks.en: Fig. 5 shows that HQG accounts for 3.4M parameters and 3.1 ms per frame. Most computation remains in feature extraction and decoder processing, indicating that tracking-aware query formation adds limited overhead.
blocks.zh: 图5显示,HQG的参数为3.4M,每帧3.1 ms. 大多数计算仍然在特征提取和解码处理中,表明跟踪-认知查询形成增加了有限的间接费用.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 研究与分析

blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies on the DanceTrack validation set to validate the main design choices of TAQ-MOTR. HOTA is used as the primary overall metric, while DetA, AssA, and IDF1 are reported to analyze detection accuracy, association quality, and identity preservation, respectively. Unless otherwise specified, all variants use the same training schedule and inference protocol as the default model, and the best result of each metric is shown in bold.
blocks.zh: 我们对DanceTrack验证组进行减速研究,以验证TAQ-MOTR的主要设计选择. HOTA是主要的总体衡量标准,而DetA、AssA和IDF1则分别用于分析检测的准确性、关联质量和身份保存。 除非另有说明,所有变体都使用与默认模型相同的训练时间表和推论协议,每个度量的最佳结果用粗体显示.

blocks.en: Table 5: Ablation of HQG priors on the full DanceTrack validation set. DP, TM, and LM denote detection proposals, track memory, and learnable memory, respectively. Original reports the published MeMOTR results [ 8 ] . Unified basic model adopts the same backbone, encoder, and pretrained weights as TAQ-MOTR while retaining the rest of MeMOTR’s tracking design. The best result for each metric is shown in bold, and unreported values are indicated by a dash.
blocks.zh: 表5 整个DanceTrack验证集中HQG前科的缩写. DP,TM,和LM分别表示检测建议,跟踪内存和可学习内存. 公布的MEMOTR结果的原始报告[8]。 统一的基本模型采用与TAQ-MOTR相同的主干、编码器和预先训练的重量,同时保留MeMOTR的其他跟踪设计。 每个度量的最佳结果以粗体表示,未报告的数值以破折号表示。

blocks.en: Relative to DP+LM, introducing track memory improves HOTA, AssA, and IDF1 by 0.9, 2.1, and 1.2 points, respectively, with a 0.6-point decrease in DetA. These results highlight the detection–association tradeoff introduced by track-state conditioning.
blocks.zh: 与DP+LM相比,引入轨迹内存分别提高了HOTA,AssA和IDF1的0.9分,2.1分和1.2分,DetA下降0.6分. 这些结果凸显出轨迹状态调节引入的检测-关联权衡.

blocks.en: In the Baselines section of Table 5 , Original reports the published MeMOTR results [ 8 ] , whereas Unified basic model reports the results of a MeMOTR control using the same backbone, encoder, and pretrained weights as TAQ-MOTR. The underlying feature-extraction architecture and pretraining are aligned, with corresponding adaptations to the training settings for the MeMOTR baseline. The comparison therefore provides an additional reference for assessing HQG rather than fully isolating its contribution. Compared with Original, Unified basic model improves DetA from 74.6 to 76.0 but reduces AssA from 55.0 to 52.3 and IDF1 from 67.1 to 66.1. As discussed in FDTA [ 27 ] , object embeddings optimized solely for detection tend to have weaker discriminative ability for association. In our setting, the backbone and encoder initialized with RT-DETRv2 detection weights may favor detection cues, potentially contributing to the observed improvement in DetA and decline in association.
blocks.zh: 在表5的基线部分,原始报告公布的MeMOTR结果[8],而统一的基本模型则报告使用与TAQ-MOTR相同的主干、编码器和预先训练的权重进行MeMOTR控制的结果。 基本特征提取架构和预培训与MEMOTR基线培训环境的相应调整保持一致。 因此,这一比较为评估总部采购组提供了补充参考,而不是完全孤立其贡献。 与原型相比,统一基本型号改进了DetA,从74.6到76.0,但AssA从55.0到52.3,IDF1从67.1到66.1. 如FDTA[27]所述,仅用于检测的嵌入物往往具有较弱的歧视性结合能力。 在我们的设定中,用RT-DETRv2检测权重初始化的骨干和编码器可能倾向于检测提示,这有可能促进观察到的DetA改进和关联性下降.

blocks.en: We additionally report detection recall (DetRe) and identity switches (IDSW) to assess missed detections and identity consistency. Relative to Unified basic model, the full HQG configuration improves HOTA, DetA, AssA, and IDF1 by 2.4, 0.5, 3.7, and 4.2 points, respectively. It also increases DetRe from 85.4 to 86.1 and reduces IDSW from 1,530 to 1,038. These results support improved overall target recall and identity association, without separately establishing a gain in recall for currently untracked objects. However, compared with DP+TM, the full configuration improves DetRe and IDF1 while increasing IDSW from 996 to 1,038, indicating a tradeoff between recall and identity switches.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们还报告了检测召回(DetRe)和身份开关(IDSW),以评估未发现的检测和身份一致性。 相对于统一基本模型,HQG的完整配置分别改进了HOTA,DetA,Assa和IDF1的2.4,0.5,3.7和4.2分. 它还将DetRe从85.4增加到86.1,并将IDSW从1,530减少到1,038. 这些成果有助于改善总目标召回和身份联系,而不会为目前没有跟踪的目标另行确定召回收益。 然而,与DP+TM相比,完整的配置改进了DetRe和DF1,同时将IDSW从996个增加到1 038个,表明召回和身份开关之间的权衡.

blocks.en: Table 6: Ablation of feature levels for constructing image-based detection proposals on the DanceTrack validation set.
blocks.zh: 表6:在DanceTrack验证集上构建基于图像的检测建议时的特征水平差异化.

blocks.en: Table 6 compares proposal feature levels. The stride-32 setting has the highest reported HOTA, DetA, and IDF1; stride-16+32 has the highest AssA but requires additional computation. We use the compact stride-32 representation as the default. The differences suggest that denser proposal features do not necessarily improve overall tracking.
blocks.zh: 表6比较了提议的特点水平。 Stride-32设置有上报最高的HOTA,DetA和IDF1;Stride-16+32拥有最高的AssA,但需要额外的计算. 我们用紧凑的32号代表作为默认。 这些差异表明,更密集的建议书功能并不一定能改善总体跟踪。

blocks.en: Table 7: Ablation of retaining recently lost tracks in HQG track memory.
blocks.zh: 表7:保留总部G轨道内存中最近丢失的轨道的差额。

blocks.en: Table 7 compares active-only HQG memory with memory that also retains recently lost tracks. The active-only default gives the highest HOTA, AssA, and IDF1, while including lost tracks improves DetA. Temporarily lost queries still remain in the decoder and retain their identities. These results favor active track states for HQG conditioning; the additional historical cues may aid detection while reducing association quality.
blocks.zh: 表7将只活跃的HQG内存与同时保留最近丢失的音轨的内存进行比较. 活动唯一的默认给予最高的HOTA,AssA和IDF1,同时包含丢失的音轨改进了DetA. 暂时丢失的询问仍留在解码器中,并保留其身份. 这些结果有利于HQG条件的主动轨道状态;额外的历史提示可能有助于检测,同时降低关联质量.

blocks.en: Table 8: Effect of memory type and shared-set token count in HQG on the DanceTrack validation set. All HQG layers use the same memory set. Fixed random memory uses frozen, randomly initialized embeddings.
blocks.zh: 表8:HQG中的内存类型和共享集符号计数对DanceTrack验证集的影响. 所有HQG层使用相同的内存集. 固定随机内存使用冷冻,随机初始化嵌入.

blocks.en: Inspired by the learnable detection queries in MeMOTR [ 8 ] , HQG uses a shared set of trainable memory tokens across all layers to encode dataset-level priors. Table 8 shows that using a shared set of 32 tokens improves HOTA from 63.3 to 65.3. Increasing the count to 64 yields further gains of 0.4 HOTA, 0.6 AssA, and 0.5 IDF1, but reduces DetA by 0.3. We select 32 as an efficiency/performance compromise, retaining competitive accuracy with fewer tokens participating in cross-attention.
blocks.zh: 受MeMOTR [8]中可学习的检测查询的启发,HQG使用一套跨越所有层的共享的可训练内存符号来编码数据集级别前身. 表8显示,使用一套共有的32个令牌将HOTA从63.3改进为65.3. 将计算数增加到64后,可进一步增加0.4 HOTA、0.6 AssA和0.5 IDF1,但DetA减少0.3。 我们选择32作为效率/业绩的折中办法,保留竞争性的准确性,减少参与交叉注意的标志。

blocks.en: To examine memory learnability, we add a fixed random memory control with the same shared set of 32 token slots, embedding dimensions, and attention operations as the learnable variant. Compared with this control, learnable memory achieves gains of 0.7 HOTA, 1.8 DetA, and 0.7 IDF1, while both obtain 56.0 AssA. These results support the contribution of learned detection priors. Freezing the embeddings reduces the number of trainable parameters while keeping the memory representation size unchanged. Fixed memory also improves HOTA and IDF1 by 1.3 and 1.6 points over using no memory, suggesting that the network can learn to use these tokens even when their embeddings are fixed. Learning the embeddings further allows the memory itself to adapt to the dataset. More effective memory representations and learning strategies remain directions for future work.
blocks.zh: 为了检查内存的可学习性,我们增加了一个固定的随机内存控制,与共享的32个符号插槽,嵌入维度,注意力操作等同为可学习的变体. 与这种控制相比,可学习的内存获得了0.7 HOTA,1.8 DetA和0.7 IDF1的增益,而两者都获得了56.0 Assa. 这些结果支持所学的检测前科的贡献。 冻结嵌入会减少可训练参数的数量,同时保持内存表达大小不变. 固定内存还比不使用内存改进了1.3分和1.6分的HOTA和IDF1,表明网络即使在嵌入固定时也能学会使用这些符号. 学习嵌入进一步使内存本身能够适应数据集. 更有效的记忆表述和学习战略仍然是今后工作的方向。

blocks.en: Table 9: Ablation of the number of HQG layers.
blocks.zh: 表9:HQG层数的缩小.

blocks.en: Table 9 compares HQG depth. Three layers yield the highest HOTA, AssA, and IDF1, whereas one layer gives the highest DetA. Six layers reduce overall performance. We therefore use three layers as the default.
blocks.zh: 表9比较了总部总部的深度。 三个层产生最高的HOTA、AssA和IDF1,而一个层产生最高的DetA。 六层降低了整体性能. 因此,我们用三层作为默认。

blocks.en: Table 10: Auxiliary supervision schedules on the DanceTrack validation set. Parenthesized epochs indicate when intermediate-layer auxiliary decoder losses are removed and when the entire auxiliary branch is disabled, respectively. None denotes training without auxiliary supervision.
blocks.zh: 表10:DanceTrack验证装置的辅助监督时间表. 括号大小的时代表示中间层辅助解码器损失何时被移除,以及整个辅助分支何时被禁用. 无一表示没有辅助监督的培训。

blocks.en: The supervision imbalance in Fig. 4 motivates additional detection supervision without changing the main branch’s association label assignment. Table 10 shows that our default auxiliary schedule improves HOTA, DetA, AssA, and IDF1 over training without the branch by 1.1, 1.7, 0.8, and 1.0 points, respectively. The timing of intermediate-layer loss removal and complete auxiliary-branch shutdown also affects the detection–association balance. Relative to the default, removing intermediate-layer losses earlier reduces DetA by 1.2 points, whereas delaying their removal increases DetA by 0.2–0.5 points but lowers AssA by 0.4–1.1 points. Advancing complete branch shutdown reduces DetA by 1.3 points; postponing it yields only a 0.2-point DetA gain while lowering IDF1 by 2.6 points. These results support sufficient auxiliary supervision during early and middle training, followed by its reduction and removal to focus late optimization on the main MOT objective.
blocks.zh: 图4中的监督不平衡,刺激了额外的检测监督,而没有改变主要分支的协会标签分配。 表10显示,我们的默认辅助时间表将HOTA、DetA、AssA和FIDF1比没有分支的训练分别提高1.1、1.7、0.8和1.0分。 中间层损失清除和完全辅助分支关闭的时间也影响到检测-关联平衡。 相对于默认,移除中间层损失更早将DetA减少1.2分,而推迟移除则将DetA增加0.2–0.5分,但将AssA减少0.4–1.1分. 推进完整的分支关闭使DetA减少1.3分;推迟它只产生0.2分的DetA增益,同时将IDF1降低2.6分. 这些成果支持在早期和中期培训期间进行充分的辅助监督,然后减少和清除这些成果,以便把最晚的优化重点放在MOT的主要目标上。

blocks.en: To examine the role of detection-query information in existing-track predictions, we evaluate Unified basic model and TAQ-MOTR on the DanceTrack validation set. After normal initialization in the first frame, two branches receive identical current-frame inputs and incoming tracking states: one retains normal SA, while the other blocks track queries from attending to detection-query keys and values. Predictions for incoming track queries are collected before lifecycle management and combined with the normal branch’s new-track initializations for evaluation. Only the normal branch updates and propagates track queries, memory, and lifecycle states, including track initialization, retention, and termination. The blocked branch does not modify this state, ensuring identical tracking histories for both branches at every frame. Normal-branch results are reevaluated under this protocol, separately from the HQG ablation in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 为了审查检测-清仓信息在现有轨道预测中的作用,我们在DanceTrack验证集上评价统一基本模型和TAQ-MOTR. 在第一帧正常初始化后,两个分支接收相同的当前帧输入和进入的跟踪状态:一个保留了正常的SA,而其他块跟踪查询从处理到检测-query键和值. 进入轨道查询的预测是在生命周期管理前收集的,并与正常分支的新轨道初始化评价相结合。 只有正常分支更新和传播跟踪查询,内存,和生命周期状态,包括轨道初始化,保留,终止. 被屏蔽的分支不会修改此状态,确保每个帧上两个分支的跟踪历史都相同. 正常分支结果在本议定书下重新评价,与表5中的总部总部产出分开。

blocks.en: Table 11: Self-attention masking analysis of tracked-object complementation. T ← D T\leftarrow D SA denotes track queries attending to detection-query keys and values: ✓ retains this interaction, whereas – blocks it. Both branches share the normal branch’s tracking history and new-track initializations.
blocks.zh: 表11:跟踪物体补充的自觉遮盖分析。 TQQD T\Leftarrow D SA 表示用于检测- query 键和值的音轨查询: QX 保留此交互, 而 – 屏蔽它 。 两个分支共享正常分支的跟踪历史和新轨初始化.

blocks.en: Table 11 provides diagnostic evidence that detection-query information supports existing-track predictions under the fixed-history protocol. Blocking this interaction reduces TAQ-MOTR’s DetA from 76.5 to 51.7, alongside drops of 12.1 AssA and 13.8 IDF1 points, reflecting changes in both detection quality and identity consistency. Unified basic model also degrades. Because inference-time masking alters the attention-input distribution, these reductions do not isolate HQG’s independent contribution. Fig. 7 illustrates where detection queries gather image evidence.
blocks.zh: 表11提供诊断证据表明,检测-清水信息支持固定历史协议下的现有轨迹预测. 阻止这种相互作用将使TAQ-MOTR的DetA从76.5降至51.7,同时减少12.1 AssA和13.8 IDF1点,反映出探测质量和身份一致性的变化。 统一的基本模型也会退化。 由于推断时间掩盖改变了注意力投入的分配,这些削减并不孤立总部总部的独立贡献。 图7说明了检测查询收集图像证据的地方。

blocks.en: 4.5 Visual Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 视觉分析

blocks.en:
Figure 6: Qualitative comparison of detection-query formation strategies on DanceTrack. Green boxes denote ground truth. Yellow, red, and blue boxes denote tracking outputs from three query-formation variants: image-based detection queries without HQG, learned queries, and HQG-generated queries (TAQ-MOTR), respectively.
The status tables report matched IDs and tracking states: “Lost” denotes no matched result, “IDSW” an identity switch, and “track” correct tracking.
In the illustrated frames, TAQ-MOTR preserves the queried identities through occlusion, crossing, and overlap; this comparison provides qualitative evidence of association behavior.
blocks.zh:
图6:DanceTrack上的检测-清水形成策略定性比较. 绿色盒子表示地面真相。 黄,红,蓝三盒分别表示跟踪来自三个查询-造型变体的产出:没有HQG的基于图像的检测查询,学到的查询,以及HQG产生的查询(TAQ-MOTR).
状态表报告与身份识别和跟踪相符:“丢失”表示没有匹配结果,“IDSW”表示身份开关,“跟踪”表示正确的跟踪。
在图示框中,TAQ-MOTR通过封存,交叉和重叠来保存被询问的身份;这一比较提供了关联行为的定性证据.

blocks.en: Fig. 6 compares detection-query formation strategies on crowded DanceTrack clips with occlusion, crossing, and target overlap. These conditions challenge propagated track queries and motivate complementary current-frame evidence. Image-based detection queries use RT-DETR-style selection from current-frame encoder features without tracking-aware interaction.
blocks.zh: 图6将拥挤的DanceTrack片段的检测-清流形成策略与掩蔽、穿越和目标重叠相比较。 这些条件对传播的跟踪查询提出了挑战,并激发了补充性的现有证据。 基于图像的检测查询使用从当前帧编码器特性中选择的RT-DETR风格,而不进行跟踪-意识交互.

blocks.en: In the first row, heavy occlusion around frame #2046 causes image-based detection queries to lose the target, while learned queries assign a different identity. Image-based detection queries subsequently recover the more visible target with an inconsistent ID. This sequence highlights the difficulty of maintaining identity from current-frame visual evidence alone when the local region remains ambiguous. The second row shows identity switches between interacting targets, with learned queries losing Target 4 during crossing. TAQ-MOTR maintains the queried targets in the tracked state across these frames. These examples illustrate more stable association and are consistent with the intended role of tracking-aware query formation, but do not isolate the mechanism responsible for the improvement.
blocks.zh: 在第一行中,围绕帧#2046的重隐蔽导致基于图像的检测查询丢失目标,而学习的查询则指定了不同的身份. 基于图像的检测查询随后以不一致的ID恢复了更可见的目标. 这一序列突出表明,在局部地区仍然含糊不清的情况下,仅从目前框架的视觉证据中保留身份就比较困难。 第二行显示交互目标之间的身份交换,学到的查询在穿越时丢失目标4. TAQ-MOTR在这些框架的跟踪状态下维持被询问的目标。 这些例子说明了更稳定的关联,符合跟踪-认知查询形成的预期作用,但并不孤立负责改进的机制.

blocks.en:
Figure 7: Query-focus visualization of detection queries on DanceTrack. The heatmaps aggregate cross-attention between detection queries and multi-scale image features in the first decoder layer; each panel is independently normalized, so heatmap colors indicate relative spatial focus rather than absolute attention magnitudes.
Green boxes mark established tracking outputs and red boxes missing or unstable outputs; these colors do not indicate track-query retention. Panels (a)–(b) show video initialization, and (c)–(e) show target discovery and challenging tracking in a crowded scene. TAQ-MOTR attends to missing or unstable output regions and crowded regions where existing tracks may require additional current-frame evidence, complementing the SA masking analysis in Table 11 .
blocks.zh:
图7:DanceTrack上的检测查询焦点可视化。 热映射在第一个解码层中,在检测查询和多尺度图像特征之间集合交叉注意;每个面板独立正常化,因此热映射颜色表明相对的空间焦点而非绝对的注意量.
绿色盒标记既定的跟踪输出和缺失或不稳定输出的红色盒;这些颜色并不表示保留轨迹。 (a)-(b)小组显示视频初始化,(c)-(e)小组显示在拥挤的场景中发现目标并进行挑战性的跟踪。 TAQ-MOTR涉及缺失或不稳定的产出区域和拥挤区域,这些区域的现有轨道可能需要额外的当前框架证据,补充表11中的SA掩码分析。

blocks.en: Fig. 7 complements the quantitative SA masking experiment in Table 11 by showing where detection queries gather current-frame image evidence during initialization, discovery of currently untracked objects, and tracking under occlusion or interaction.
blocks.zh: 图7补充了表11中的定量SA遮掩实验,显示探测查询在初始化过程中收集当前帧图像证据的地方,发现目前没有跟踪的物体,以及在掩蔽或相互作用下进行跟踪.

blocks.en: In Fig. 7 (a)–(b), the first two video frames, detection queries initially provide broad object evidence before reliable track states are established. Learned queries retain similar focus after propagated track queries take over targets, while image-based detection queries mainly follow visual saliency. Once track states become available, TAQ-MOTR focuses more on the crowded central region with overlap and occlusion while retaining coverage of visible targets. In the dense scene of Fig. 7 (c)–(e), learned queries remain diffuse, and image-based detection queries follow visual saliency. TAQ-MOTR attends to a locally ambiguous region, shifts toward the red-highlighted target in (d), and refocuses on other crowded regions after that target acquires an established output in (e). These patterns are consistent with detection-query focus adapting to current-frame evidence and existing track states, supporting discovery of currently untracked objects and complementary cues for retained tracks. The maps show where image cues are gathered; the SA masking experiment examines how existing-track predictions depend on that information under a fixed history. Neither identifies individual restored detections. The recall claim remains based on the overall DetRe evaluation.
blocks.zh: 在图7(a)-(b)中,前两个视频帧,探测查询在建立可靠的轨道状态之前,最初提供广泛的物体证据。 所学的查询在传播的音轨查询接管目标后仍保持相似的焦点,而基于图像的检测查询主要遵循视觉的显著性. 一旦有轨电车状态,TAQ-MOTR更注重拥挤的中部地区,重叠和隔离,同时保留可见目标的覆盖范围. 在图7(c)-(e)的密集场景中,学到的询问仍然分散,基于图像的检测询问跟随视觉的显著性. TAQ-MOTR关注当地一个模棱两可的地区,转向(d)中红色突出的目标,并在(e)中目标获得既定产出后,重新关注其他拥挤地区。 这些模式符合适应当前框架证据和现有轨迹状态的探测-排水重点,支持发现目前没有轨迹的物体和保留轨迹的补充提示。 地图显示收集图像提示的地点;SA遮掩实验考察了现有轨迹预测如何在固定历史中依赖于该信息. 也没有识别个人恢复检测。 召回索赔仍然是根据DetRe的总体评价提出的。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: HQG does not explicitly estimate or gate prior reliability. Under dense overlap and similar appearance, image proposals may become ambiguous and propagated tracks may drift or confuse identities. The lost-track ablation in Table 7 shows that adding uncertain track states can improve detection but degrade association and identity preservation. Improving robustness to unreliable priors remains an open direction.
blocks.zh: HQG没有明确估计或锁定先前的可靠性. 在密集的重叠和类似外观下,图像提案可能变得模糊不清,传播的轨道可能漂移或混淆身份。 表7中丢失的轨道衰减表明,增加不确定的轨道状态可以改善检测,但可降解关联和身份保护。 将稳健性提升到不可靠的前科仍然是一个开放方向。

blocks.en: The compact stride-32 proposals in Table 6 may also limit sensitivity to small targets, local overlaps, and abrupt shape changes. Selective use of finer multi-scale evidence could address this limitation while preserving efficient query formation.
blocks.zh: 表6中的紧凑式32提案也可能限制对小目标的敏感性、局部重叠和突然的形状变化。 选择性使用更精细的多尺度证据可以解决这一限制,同时保持高效的查询形成.

blocks.en: Finally, auxiliary supervision relies on a coarse, manually calibrated schedule whose transition points influence the balance between detection and association performance. Learning to adapt the strength and duration of auxiliary supervision to the model’s training progress remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 最后,辅助监督依赖于粗糙的手工校准时间表,其过渡点影响检测和关联性能之间的平衡. 学习使辅助监督的力量和期限适应模式的培训进展,仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: TAQ-MOTR forms detection queries from current-frame image evidence, track memory, and learnable priors before shared decoding. A training-only auxiliary branch strengthens detection learning through independent label assignments while preserving identity-based assignment in the main branch. Experiments on DanceTrack, SportsMOT, and BFT show improved association and identity preservation, with the highest HOTA among the compared TBP methods. Ablations support tracking-aware query formation and staged auxiliary supervision. The results motivate conditioning detection queries on evolving track states while improving the robustness of memory priors and auxiliary scheduling.
blocks.zh: TAQ-MOTR从当前帧图像证据中形成检测查询,跟踪内存,以及共享解码前的可学习前科. 只有一个训练辅助分支通过独立标签任务加强检测学习,同时保留主分支基于身份的任务. 关于DanceTrack、SportsMOT和BFT的实验显示联系和身份保护得到改善,在比较的TBP方法中HOTA最高。 疏导支持跟踪-意识查询形成,并设置辅助监理. 这些结果激励了在不断发展的轨道状态上调节检测查询,同时提高了内存前科和辅助调度的稳健性.
